text: From cocoon to cloth, in order. Harvest the cocoons. Stifle them, killing the pupa before the moth can break the thread. Strip off the loose floss. Cook them to soften the gum. Reel the filaments together in a filature. Then degum, dye and weave. Raw silk is mostly the protein fibroin, held together by the gum sericin.
